_source: Hover cards for the action bar's close-quarters actions (Hud.action_help), like net_help.json for the NET panel. Short paraphrases of CPR core p.168-169, p.177, p.183-184 and p.180 (Put Out Fire) as distilled in docs/rules/combat.md sections 3, 5 and 7; hand-edited. Each entry: name, cost, text (what it does), key (its roll or numbers), page, book (default CPR core; SPM = Single Player Mode). Ids are Encounter.grapple_options().

grab.name: Grab
grab.text: Hold a foe next to you. You both take -2 while it lasts; they can't move.
grab.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs theirs, ties to them

choke.name: Choke
choke.text: Damage equal to your BODY to the one you hold, ignoring armor. A choke that would kill leaves them Unconscious at 1 HP; three Rounds running puts anyone out.

throw.name: Throw
throw.text: Throw the one you hold down: damage equal to your BODY, ignoring armor. The grapple ends and they're Prone.

shield.name: Human Shield
shield.text: Hold the one you grapple between you and the guns: they take the ranged shots, but not melee or Aimed Shots at your head. They can't dodge. If they die, their body is a shield with HP equal to their BODY.
shield.key: cover · no dodge for the shield

release.name: Release
release.text: Let go. The grapple and its -2 end.

escape.name: Escape
escape.text: Break free. Win and your Move Action is back if you haven't used it.
escape.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs the holder's, ties to them

break.name: Break Hold
break.text: Pry an ally loose. Stand next to whoever holds them.
break.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs the holder's, ties to them

get_up.name: Get Up
get_up.text: Stand up. While Prone you have no Move Action.

put_out.name: Put Out Fire
put_out.text: Beat out the flames. Until you do, the fire hits your HP at the end of every Turn, ignoring armor.

spoof.name: Spoof
spoof.text: Fool a camera or alarm panel within 3 squares. Success wins a die back on the detection clock and the camera stops reporting; failure rolls the clock. Once a turn, and once per device.
spoof.key: TECH + Electronics/Security Tech (+ Field Expertise) vs DV15
